definitions.site_filter: total_count>=10 independently in each of all nine samples
definitions.window_filter: sum of 16 complete C/T pattern counts>=20 independently in each of all nine samples
definitions.site_aggregation: Equal donor weights at each site: A=mean_site h(mean_donor p); B=mean_site mean_donor h(p). No pooling of counts across donors.
definitions.window_marginals: Derived exclusively from the same 16 complete-pattern counts as the joint entropy, not from the broader single-site counts.
definitions.population_window_means: Equal-weight mean of window estimands within each donor, followed by equal-weight mean across three donors.
definitions.entropy_units: Bits per CpG for binary site quantities; bits per four-CpG window for joint entropy, marginal sum and their difference.
definitions.rarefaction: Exact expectation of the plug-in entropy for a size-20 sample without replacement from each observed window. Integer binomial-coefficient hypergeometric probabilities, evaluated in floating point. No simulation, iterations or random seed.
definitions.total_correlation: Marginal entropy sum minus joint entropy, computed within each window. The depth-20 version is the expectation of this empirical difference at depth 20.
definitions.source_integrity_scope: The input CSV hashes and count invariants are checked here. PAT integrity and PAT-to-CSV reproduction are documented separately.
definitions.uncertainty: Descriptive donor points and equal-weight means only. Three matched biological donors; no confidence intervals, p-values or assumption of independent sites/windows.
definitions.physical_coordinates: Not computed: no CpG-index-to-hg38-base-pair reference is an input.
